about: The animation lane's fixed questions for the parts library (P0): new R6 moves in a brief's words, written before any method was run on them. Every method's top answers are pooled and labelled blind by two labellers (labels.json); `kit parts anim eval` scores each method on them. Add a question only from real work, never to suit a method.

questions.brief: spinning heel kick: the fighter turns his back, pivots on the support foot, the kicking leg whips round at head height, then lands back in stance
two-handed spear thrust: step in on the lead foot, the rear hand drives the shaft forward to full reach, a short hold at the point, then pull back to guard
shield bash: brace behind a round shield on the left arm, a short step in, shove the shield forward with the shoulder, the body leans into it, recover
two-handed hammer slam: lift the hammer high over the head in a long wind-up, crouch as it drops, the head hits the ground hard with a hit-stop, slow recovery
dodge roll: drop low, a forward shoulder roll across the floor, come up on one knee, then stand, quick and low
bow shot: draw the string back to the cheek, hold the aim, release, the bow arm stays still while the string hand flicks back
backflip kick: plant both feet, jump back, the legs whip over the head and one leg kicks up at the peak, land in a crouch
sword parry and riposte: the blade comes up across the body to block, the edge meets the hit, then a quick thrust back from the parry
heavy hit stagger: hit in the chest, the torso snaps back, the feet stumble two steps backward, the arms flail, then the body regains balance
dual pistol reload: spin both pistols on the trigger fingers, the empty magazines drop, slap new ones in against the hips, snap back to aim
